lines.amount: 1.5 l; ~8 % of raw chip weight (96 g) absorbed
lines.reference: Oil, sunflower, linoleic (less than 60%) — USDA FDC 171017: 884 kcal / 100 g
Vinegar, distilled — USDA FDC 172237 (SA brown/white spirit vinegar): 18 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions that change the number: oil absorbed is ~8 % of the raw chip weight (96 g of the 1.5 l): thick-cut, single-fried at 160 °C and soft, so less than crisp fries; vinegar has no carbohydrate. Sanity check: UK Public Health England takeaway chip-shop chips are 214 kcal / 100 g with 8.4 g fat, and FatSecret's generic chip-shop chips are 278 kcal / 100 g. Ours are ~190–220 kcal / 100 g depending on how much water the chips lose (~820–940 g cooked), so ~450 kcal for a quarter. Crisp thin fast-food fries (USDA FDC 170698) are 312 kcal / 100 g.
